title: Wing Commander - Prophecy
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Shields, armor; missiles
Space combat against the alien Nephilim (with the Kilrathi now allies); shields absorb hits, then armor
Missions are briefed before launch; your wingmen fly with you

Fighter guns and missiles
Fighters from the mission list include the Wasp (booster on/off), Vampire, Devastator bomber and Panther
Afterburner for chasing and escaping; missiles lock on after a short hold

Lock missiles; break off to avoid fire
Mission types in the ROM: Sweep and Rendezvous, Patrol, Wasp Intercept, Tactical Retreat, Convoy Rescue, Shrike Escort, Cruiser Assault, Hydra Fleet Assault, Mine the Jump Point, Relay Station Insertion/Defense, Treasure Hunt, MIA Recovery, Strike Bomber Assault and more

rows: hit turrets first, then the hull
the Stingray Cluster and other systems; wormhole gates appear in late missions

widgets.text:
Missiles
Missiles by type (dumb-fire, heat seekers, torpedoes on bombers); guns use energy

Medals
Medals and kills on your record
Wingman kills count for the squadron

Missions
Campaign missions in order, with retreat and rescue branches
